verdict.rationale: GitHub evidence shows an official smithery-cli with commands for searching/adding MCP servers, finding/calling tools, and installing skills — a genuine CLI for AI-native workflows. However, the CLI's provenance and maintenance status are thin (single repo listing, no adoption/independent corroboration, no mention in official smithery.ai docs pages). Missing for 10: first-party docs referencing the CLI, independent hands-on validation, breadth of commands/versioning history.
